facts.business: Religare Enterprises Limited is an RBI-registered Core Investment Company (CIC) providing strategic direction, governance oversight, and long-term capital stewardship across financial services and health insurance businesses including MSME lending, affordable housing finance, retail and institutional broking, and health insurance.

segments.name: Investment & Financial Activities - Other Investment Activities

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure (addition to non-current assets other than financial instruments, deferred tax assets and right arising under insurance contracts)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Ongoing income tax litigations and related tax demands (Note 47(a)(III) and 47(a)(IV)). 2) Non-consolidation of Religare Capital Markets Limited (RCML) due to management's assessment of non-existence of control through voting rights (Note 2.2 C).

key_risks: Prudent underwriting and asset quality focus needed due to self-employed and informal income profile of significant portion of borrower base in affordable housing finance
Ongoing income tax litigations and related tax demands
Non-consolidation of Religare Capital Markets Limited due to assessment of non-existence of control
Regulatory approvals pending for proposed demerger from RBI, SEBI, NCLT and other authorities
Governance review in progress for RFL and RHDFCL to identify potential instances of misconduct
Legal disputes regarding trademark usage and preference shares redemption with RHC Holdings group
facts.related_party_note: Properties pledged in favour of Religare Finvest Limited (RFL) as security for various loans to group companies of RHC Holdings Private Limited. Company has not redeemed 250 Lakhs preference shares issued to RHC Finance Private Limited due for redemption on August 30, 2021 with redemption value of Rs 4,212.75 Lakhs. Brand license agreement executed with RHC Holding Private Limited. Elive Infotech Private Limited filed application seeking sale of Religare Trademark along with payment of approx. Rs 323 Crores for unauthorized usage.
